title: 合上盒子
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: ONE original full-bleed vertical 9:16 watercolor story illustration for one locked narration shot. Use every input according to its explicitly labelled role; preserve existing named identities, not just species. Input 1: canonical identity reference for 皮皮 (pipi); preserve this character exactly. Input 2: Pipi clothing sheet only; follow the exact outfit specified below. Input 3: visual continuity reference.
Visible characters: 皮皮 (pipi). Exact total number of visible characters: 1. Do not draw extra background animals. Standing body-height ratios (not ear or tail tips): 皮皮 1.0. Pipi wears ONLY the LEFT daytime outfit from the wardrobe sheet: dusty blue overalls, oatmeal shirt, blue cloth shoes, small yellow backpack. No star cap in daytime. Scene continuity: 门廊至卧室的傍晚连续场景。
The SINGLE visual moment and framing: 皮皮将木盒盖合上，抱着它安静地回到卧室。
Emotional performance for this exact beat: 期待感稍收，动作轻缓认真。
Mandatory pose/prop state (overrides neutral model-sheet poses): 一个皮皮、一个木盒；不出现被装进去的声音或落叶。
Style: hand-painted gentle watercolor on fine warm paper, muted natural hues, soft edges and rounded shapes, quiet storybook mood, no glossy 3D or photorealism. Daylight scenes use soft greens and warm daylight, not bedroom amber tint. Night scenes use soft warm lamplight and muted gray-blue windows. Composition: full-bleed vertical 9:16. Keep all important faces, hands, feet, biscuits, fabric folds and other story actions in the upper 68% of the image. Bottom 32% is low-detail negative space for later subtitles, with no crucial objects there. Make the specified story state visually understandable. Text: NONE. No words, labels, subtitles, numbers, logos, watermark, speech bubbles, panels, frames or collage. Do not reproduce model sheets, multiple versions of a character, or wardrobe lineups. Each named character appears exactly once. This is a new single coherent scene, not a copy of the references. No motion streaks or implied camera zoom. Never turn a metaphor into a real transformation: yellow blankets remain fabric, imagined grassy softness is not actual grass growing in bed. No new story events. Continuity-specific locks: Do not depict sound as visible letters, music notes, sound waves, glowing objects, or captured material. Reference roles: Input 1 is the canonical identity reference for pipi; preserve this exact character. Input 2 shows Pipi's day and sleep outfits; use only the outfit specified in the prompt. Input 3: This is the same single pale honey-pine lidded box; preserve its rounded corners and small scale.
